about: A fenced block's info string read as a prototype (prompts/blocks/prototypes.md): `prototype-chat` and `prototype-page` with an optional title on the same line, and bare `prototype` as the inline kind; anything else is the code block it is (`null`). The title is the fence's, else the page's own <title>, whitespace collapsed, at most 80 characters. LLeMbas: services/prototypes.py parse_info and title_for; CLI: src/prototype/fence.ts.
